newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Seoul court sentences Chun Doo Hwan to death.
newsitem.headline: Seoul court sentences Chun Doo Hwan to death.

text.p: A South Korean court sentenced former president Chun Doo Hwan to death on Monday on charges relating to a 1979 coup, Yonhap television reported.
Chun was found guilty of masterminding the putsch and of attempted murder of his then senior officers. At the time he was an army general.
Chun's presidential successor, Roh Tae-woo, was sentenced to 22-1/2 years in jail on similar charges.
Chun was cleared of a separate charge of murder in connection with a massacre in 1980 of pro-democracy protesters in the southern city of Kwangju.
